title: Shion no Ou: The Flowers of Hard Blood
native: しおんの王 - The Flowers of Hard Blood
synopsis:
Shion no Ou follows the story of Yasuoka Shion, a 13-year-old Shougi player with a past of tragedy. Shion's parents were brutally murdered in front of her when she was 5 years old. The murderer sat down with her and challenged her to a game of Shougi, after telling her that if she wanted to stay alive she should forget how to speak, and forget what happened that night.

Now Shion has entered the realm of female pro Kishi, mute but strong. As her playing gathers more and more attention, so do the questions about her past and the brutal murder she witnessed. Shion's memories slowly come back, and the mystery begins to unravel, thread by thread.

episodes.title: Shion's Path
episodes.synopsis: Eight years after witnessing her parents' death, Shion qualifies herself as a professional shogi player. However, her precocious career starts to draw unwanted attention.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.synopsis: Shion is saved in the nick of time from a dangerous stalker. However, her drama continues as she receives a threatening letter before an important match.

episodes.title: The Sound of Shogi Pieces
episodes.synopsis: A little relief comes to Shion when the man who attacked her six months before is finally arrested. She also recognizes Ayumi as the boy who saved her at that time.

episodes.title: Demon Hand
episodes.synopsis: Shion has another fiery match against Ayumi, while the police discovers that the man who killed her parents started to move again.

episodes.title: Courageous Move
episodes.synopsis: Shion is hospitalized after having a glimpse of the night when she lost her parents. Meanwhile, Nikaido and Ayumi have their first duel.

episodes.title: Provocation
episodes.synopsis: After Shion recovers, she goes on a trip with her family. Upon returning, she and Nikaido receive a sudden request from Hani-Meijin's younger brother, Satoru.

episodes.title: Playing Pieces
episodes.synopsis: Shion and Nikaido have their first match as a demonstration of their abilities to Satoru, who wants to create an all new, unrestricted shogi tournament.

episodes.title: The Door to Dreams
episodes.synopsis: Shion visits Ayumi's mother at the hospital, and later, she and Ayumi start to make plans for the upcoming tournament.

episodes.title: Master & Apprentice
episodes.synopsis: Nikaido has a tough match in the tournament against Kamizono who also happens to be Ayumi's master. Kamizono however, is not at the best of his health.

episodes.title: Good Luck Charm
episodes.synopsis: Shion's next opponent is a young prodigy who polished his skills in online matches, and learned from an anonymous source a way to leave her mind unstable.

episodes.title: Doubt
episodes.synopsis: Shion received a threatening call from the murderer, and Hisatani gets himself in trouble when the police finds out that it was made from his cell phone.

episodes.title: Fox's Prediction
episodes.synopsis: Shion, Ayumi and Nikaido prepare themselves as each one has a strong enemy to face in order to gain a place in the finals.

episodes.title: Duality
episodes.synopsis: During Shion's match with Satoru, she starts to get a glimpse of his hostility towards her.

episodes.title: Timbre of a Challenge
episodes.synopsis: Nikaido discovers Ayumi's secret, but decides to not expose him. Later the tournament's remaining contestants decide their opponents in the finals.

episodes.title: Time's Answer
episodes.synopsis: Shion's first opponent in the finals is none other than her foster father. During the long match, she eagerly looks for a way to defeat him, while he reminisces about the time when she became his apprentice.

episodes.title: Watching From Heaven
episodes.synopsis: Ayumi is devastated with the death of his mother, and looks for a reason to continue playing shogi before his match with Satoru.

episodes.title: Mind Reading
episodes.synopsis: Shion's got a chance to play against Satoru once more in the tournament's semi-finals, but during the match, he questions her about the night her parents were murdered, which brings up some memories she had long forgotten.

episodes.title: Halted Time
episodes.synopsis: Shion and Satoru's match continues, while Hani-Meijin introduces Ayumi as his disciple.

episodes.title: Recalling Move
episodes.synopsis: Satoru and Ayumi meet up and from the evidence figure out who the murderer is but are unsure of motive. In the mean time, the police are looking up Satoru after what he said to Shion after their match.

episodes.title: Demon Killer
episodes.synopsis: Shion starts remembering more things about the murder incident. Hani-Meijin and Shion play where they had left off 8 years ago.

episodes.title: The True Criminal
episodes.synopsis: Purposely goaded by Hani-Meijin, Shion fully remembers the incident. Meanwhile new evidence is found.

episodes.title: Towards Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: The evidence is conclusive, Hani-Meijin is the killer of Shion's parent's and his younger brother's girlfriend. Despite this, the match goes on. Hani-Meijin confesses that he killed Shion's parents to raise up a competitor that would be strong enough to take him to new heights and claiming he "raised her", but to do so, he must win the match. However, Shion wins with a perfect defense. She regains her voice to tell Hani-Meijin that she is not a product of him, but her family and friends. Hani-Meijin is arrested and Shion is promoted to a 4-dan professional kishi. Ayumi is shown winning a match and also becoming a professional kishi. Nikaido announces her intentions to become one as well. The final scene shows Shion in a match as a 5-dan and having retained her voice.
